query: Which structural demand model and identification strategy (nested logit, mixed logit, instruments) most reliably estimate cross-category substitution and leakage from full-basket data?

response.query: Which structural demand model and identification strategy (nested logit, mixed logit, instruments) most reliably estimate cross-category substitution and leakage from full-basket data?
response.answer: Mixed logit models and instrumental variables are most reliable for estimating cross-category substitution and leakage from full-basket data. Mixed logit accounts for preference heterogeneity, while instruments address endogeneity issues.
